evidence: In 3d_top, 3d_iso and 3d_iso_back all bodies (four terminal blocks, pin header, SOIC, channel passives) are clearly separated with visible board surface between them and no stacking or intersection.
Both iso views show every body seated flush on the PCB surface with no floating, sunken, or tilted components.
In 3d_top the SOIC body is centered over its pad rows, the terminal bodies cover their pad pairs, and each channel-strip passive body sits on its own footprint with no displaced parts.
All four screw terminals form a uniform aligned row at the bottom edge with wire openings facing outward, and the polarized diodes D1-D4 are oriented identically in each channel strip.

The 2d view shows four identical vertical channel strips (C-D-R-R) in aligned columns over their terminals, with the ADC cluster centered and the I2C header at top, reading as tight grid-aligned groups.
